title: Material for MkDocs custom properties
description: The --md-* CSS custom properties the theme styles itself with.

name.description: The custom property including the two leading hyphens, for example --md-primary-fg-color.

group.description: The part of the page the property paints; one entry of MkDocsMaterialCssVariableGroup.

isColor.description: Whether the value is a colour, which makes the IDE offer a colour swatch for it.

descriptionKey.description: Key of the one line description in messages/MkDocsMaterialBundle.properties.
